description: Jurassic World Rebirth has some of the best water integration we have seen in cinema. The way the CG elements in the water, and the CG water itself, blend and connect with the real water captured in the real plates is practically flawless. Bravo, ILM.
title: Is This the Best Water Integration in Cinema?
